---
title: "Course Notes"
---

```{r}
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
```

The refereed course notes listed below fulfill the guidelines listed under [Information for Authors of Course Notes](author_coursenotes.qmd).

If you use JIBLM materials, please consider emailing the Submissions Editor with a constructive review of your experience; which notes did you use and how did they work for your students?  Helpful reviews will be posted with the issue they reviewed. 

This table is sortable. Click on a column heading to sort by that column. Click on a title to access these notes.

```{r}
#| include: false


materials <- read_csv("contents.csv") |>
  mutate(vol = as.integer(str_sub(Issue, 5, 6)))


materials <- materials |>
  mutate( Title = paste0("<a href=\"./Course_Notes/v", vol, "/v", vol, ".html\" >", Title, "</a>" ))


  
#  separate_wider_regex(Issue, patterns = c("No. ", v = "[0-9]+", " [(]", date = "[A-Za-z]+ [0-9]+", " [)]"))

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

# pageLength sets the default number of rows to display 
options(DT.options = list(pageLength = 100, order = list(4, 'desc')))


#materials |>
#  datatable(rownames = FALSE, style = 'bootstrap', class = "table-condensed table-striped", escape = FALSE)

materials |>
  separate_wider_regex(Issue, patterns = c("No.\\s", Volume = "[0-9]+", " [(]", date = "[A-Za-z]+\\.?\\s[0-9]+", "[)]")) |>
  mutate(Date = format(my(date), "%Y %b")) |>
  select(!date & !vol) |>
  relocate(Date, .after = Volume) |>
  rename( Issue = Volume ) |>
  select( !Reviews ) |>
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, style = 'bootstrap', class = "table-condensed table-striped", escape = FALSE)
```
